review_notes: Later coverage of the same Phalelung-7 house landslide confirms one body recovered while the other two people were still missing; only one death is established.
The Sisne-6 Raniko failure is explicitly reported as a landslide blocking the Mid-Hill Highway; the mud/debris wording in the article concerns a separate Salyan incident.
The Kalikhola landslide blocked the Narayangadh-Muglin road for about 30 hours, and the report explicitly states that one person died in the landslide.
The Midigaun, Bungal-5 landslide buried a house and killed the two named children; four other people were injured.
The Namsi bridge obstruction is described as rocks falling from above with concern about additional falling rocks, supporting rockfall rather than a general landslide label.
The Majhphant-3 landslide buried the cotton-industry building; one girl died while eight others were injured.
The Kirtipur landslide is documented specifically because it blocked the Mid-Hill Highway linking Achham and Surkhet.
The Ghumaune dry landslide buried vehicles; the article explicitly reports two fatalities and two injured people.
The bridge no. 3 landslide buried an excavator and killed its driver, establishing one death.
The Bagchaur-12 house landslide killed the three named siblings; the claimed total of eight is not supported by this incident report.
The Liping/Bhotekoshi landslide blocked the Tatopani road and stranded trucks and containers, so the record is a road-obstruction event.
The Nagdi Khola dry landslide damaged vehicles, injured one person, and blocked the road; the report states no one else was harmed, supporting zero deaths.
The incident was collapse of a soil mound created during riverbank embankment work while people were sitting on it, not a documented natural landslide process.
The Malika-6 Gulmi house landslide killed five members of the same family; all five bodies were recovered.
The Sunchhahari-5 Kamidanda house landslide resulted in one confirmed death; the four-year-old child remained missing in the report.
The Gunadi slope failure buried workers constructing roadside drainage; two workers died and one was injured.
The Fhatakshila/Ratopahiro landslide repeatedly blocked the Helambu Highway, making road obstruction the supported event type.
The Biruwa-6 landslide killed three people and injured five; five is the injury count, not the death count.
